title: jazzy slovakian falafel wrap
description: savory, bouncy, and perfect for brunch, this slovakian dish features crispy falafel, leafy greens, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: drain and rinse the chickpeas, then pat dry with a paper towel.
in a food processor, combine chickpeas, feta cheese, onion, garlic, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil. process until coarsely chopped.
transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in some chopped parsley.
using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 falafel patties.
place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each patty.
bake the falafel for 18-20 minutes, flipping halfway through, until they are golden brown and crispy.
while the falafel is baking, prepare the tahini dressing by whisking together 2 tablespoons of tahini, 2 tablespoons of lemon juice, and 1 minced garlic clove.
warm the whole wheat wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
assemble the wraps by spreading a tablespoon of tahini dressing on the wrap, followed by a few falafel patties, some mixed greens, and a sprinkle of parsley.
